description: Defines the LoanOfficerAssignmentHistory entity class, representing historical records of loan officer assignments with methods for creation, updates, and date comparisons.

classes.name: LoanOfficerAssignmentHistory
classes.description: Entity class for tracking historical loan officer assignments, including start and end dates, with methods for creation and updates.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new LoanOfficerAssignmentHistory instance with specified loan, loan officer, and start date.

methods.name: updateStartDate
methods.description: Updates the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: updateEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: matchesStartDateOf
methods.description: Checks if the given date matches the start date.

methods.name: isBeforeStartDate
methods.description: Checks if the given date is before the start date.

methods.name: isCurrentRecord
methods.description: Determines if the record is current (end date is null).

methods.name: isEndDateAfter
methods.description: Checks if the end date is after a given date.

methods.name: isSameLoanOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the given staff is the same as the loan officer in this record.
